imo-1975-q1.summary: Let $x_1\ge x_2\ge\cdots\ge x_n$ and $y_1\ge y_2\ge\cdots\ge y_n$ be real numbers. If $(z_1,\ldots,z_n)$ is any permutation of $(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$, prove that $$\sum_{i=1}^n(x_i-y_i)^2\le\sum_{i=1}^n(x_i-z_i)^2.$$
imo-1975-q1.summaryZh: 设实数列满足 $x_1\ge x_2\ge\cdots\ge x_n$ 与 $y_1\ge y_2\ge\cdots\ge y_n$。若 $(z_1,\ldots,z_n)$ 是 $(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$ 的任意排列，证明 $$\sum_{i=1}^n(x_i-y_i)^2\le\sum_{i=1}^n(x_i-z_i)^2$$。
imo-1975-q1.answer: Pairing the two sequences in the same decreasing order minimizes the sum of squared differences.
imo-1975-q1.answerZh: 把两个数列按相同的递减顺序配对时，平方差之和最小。

methods.title: Remove inversions by pairwise exchanges
methods.titleZh: 用成对交换逐一消去逆序
steps: For $x\ge x'$ and $y\ge y'$, direct expansion gives $$(x-y')^2+(x'-y)^2-(x-y)^2-(x'-y')^2=2(x-x')(y-y')\ge0.$$ Thus assigning the larger $y$ to the larger $x$ never gives a larger cost than crossing the two assignments.

Start with the permutation $(z_1,\ldots,z_n)$. If it is not decreasing, there are indices $i<j$ with $z_i<z_j$. Because $x_i\ge x_j$, Step 1 shows that exchanging $z_i$ and $z_j$ cannot increase $\sum_k(x_k-z_k)^2$.
Repeatedly remove such inversions. Since a finite permutation has only finitely many inversions, the process ends with the entries of $z$ in decreasing order.

That decreasing list is precisely $(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$, including repeated values. Hence the final cost is $\sum_i(x_i-y_i)^2$ and is no greater than the initial cost $\sum_i(x_i-z_i)^2$, proving the inequality.
stepsZh: 若 $x\ge x'$ 且 $y\ge y'$，直接展开可得 $$(x-y')^2+(x'-y)^2-(x-y)^2-(x'-y')^2=2(x-x')(y-y')\ge0$$。所以把较大的 $y$ 配给较大的 $x$，代价不会比交叉配对更大。
从排列 $(z_1,\ldots,z_n)$ 出发。若它不是递减的，则存在 $i<j$ 使 $z_i<z_j$。又因 $x_i\ge x_j$，由第一步可知交换 $z_i,z_j$ 不会增大 $\sum_k(x_k-z_k)^2$。
不断消去这样的逆序。有限排列的逆序数有限，因此过程最终得到按递减顺序排列的 $z$。
这个递减序列正是 $(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$，重复值也按重数保留。因此最终的平方差和为 $\sum_i(x_i-y_i)^2$，且不大于初始值 $\sum_i(x_i-z_i)^2$，结论成立。

imo-1975-q2.summary: Let $a_1<a_2<a_3<\cdots$ be an infinite increasing sequence of positive integers. Prove that for every $p\ge1$, infinitely many terms $a_m$ can be written as $$a_m=xa_p+ya_q,$$ where $x,y$ are positive integers and $q>p$.
imo-1975-q2.summaryZh: 设 $a_1<a_2<a_3<\cdots$ 是正整数构成的无限递增序列。证明：对每个 $p\ge1$，都有无穷多个项 $a_m$ 可写成 $$a_m=xa_p+ya_q,$$ 其中 $x,y$ 为正整数且 $q>p$。
imo-1975-q2.answer: For each fixed $p$, one may choose a single $q>p$ and take $y=1$ for infinitely many $m$.
imo-1975-q2.answerZh: 对每个固定的 $p$，可以选定同一个 $q>p$，并对无穷多个 $m$ 取 $y=1$。

methods.title: Use an infinite residue class modulo $a_p$
methods.titleZh: 在模 $a_p$ 的无穷剩余类中选取各项
steps: Fix $p\ge1$. There are only $a_p$ residue classes modulo $a_p$, but the sequence contains infinitely many terms. Hence at least one residue class contains infinitely many of the $a_i$.
Choose one term $a_q$ from this infinite class with $q>p$. After deleting the finitely many terms with index at most $q$, infinitely many terms $a_m$ of the same class remain, all with $m>q$.
For every such $m$, $a_m\equiv a_q\pmod{a_p}$. Thus $$x=\frac{a_m-a_q}{a_p}$$ is an integer. Since the sequence is strictly increasing and $m>q$, we have $a_m>a_q$, so $x$ is positive.
Taking $y=1$ gives $a_m=xa_p+ya_q$. This representation holds for infinitely many $m$, with positive integers $x,y$ and the fixed index $q>p$. Since $p$ was arbitrary, the assertion follows.
stepsZh: 固定 $p\ge1$。模 $a_p$ 只有 $a_p$ 个剩余类，而数列有无穷多项，所以至少有一个剩余类包含无穷多个 $a_i$。
从这个无穷剩余类中选取一项 $a_q$，使 $q>p$。删去指标不超过 $q$ 的有限多项后，同一剩余类中仍有无穷多个 $a_m$，并且它们都满足 $m>q$。
对每个这样的 $m$，有 $a_m\equiv a_q\pmod{a_p}$，所以 $$x=\frac{a_m-a_q}{a_p}$$ 是整数。因数列严格递增且 $m>q$，故 $a_m>a_q$，从而 $x$ 为正整数。
取 $y=1$，便有 $a_m=xa_p+ya_q$。对无穷多个 $m$，这个表示都成立，且 $x,y$ 为正整数、固定的 $q>p$。由于 $p$ 任意，结论得证。

imo-1975-q3.summary: On the sides of an arbitrary triangle $ABC$, construct externally triangles $ABR$, $BCP$, and $CAQ$ such that $\angle CBP=\angle CAQ=45^\circ$, $\angle BCP=\angle ACQ=30^\circ$, and $\angle ABR=\angle BAR=15^\circ$. Prove that $\angle QRP=90^\circ$ and $QR=RP$.
imo-1975-q3.summaryZh: 在任意三角形 $ABC$ 的三边外侧分别作三角形 $ABR,BCP,CAQ$，使 $\angle CBP=\angle CAQ=45^\circ$，$\angle BCP=\angle ACQ=30^\circ$，且 $\angle ABR=\angle BAR=15^\circ$。证明 $\angle QRP=90^\circ$ 且 $QR=RP$。
imo-1975-q3.answer: The vectors satisfy $q-r=i(p-r)$ in suitable complex coordinates; hence $RQ$ is a $90^\circ$ rotation of $RP$ with the same length.
imo-1975-q3.answerZh: 在适当的复坐标中有 $q-r=i(p-r)$；因此向量 $RQ$ 是向量 $RP$ 旋转 $90^\circ$ 后所得，且长度不变。

methods.title: Encode the external constructions by complex rotations
methods.titleZh: 用复数旋转表示三个外接构造
steps: Identify the plane with the complex plane. After a similarity and, if necessary, a reflection, take $a=0$, $b=1$, and $c=u+iv$ with $v>0$. Denote the coordinates of $P,Q,R$ by $p,q,r$, and set $$t=\frac{\sqrt3-1}{2}.$$

The remaining angles at $P$ and $Q$ are both $105^\circ$. By the sine rule, $$\frac{BP}{BC}=\frac{AQ}{AC}=\frac{\sin30^\circ}{\sin105^\circ}=\sqrt2\,t.$$ The external orientations rotate $BC$ clockwise by $45^\circ$ and $AC$ counterclockwise by $45^\circ$, so $$p=1+t(1-i)(c-1),\qquad q=t(1+i)c.$$
The triangle $ABR$ is isosceles and lies on the side of $AB$ opposite $C$. Its altitude gives $$r=\frac12-\frac i2\tan15^\circ=\frac12+i\left(t-\frac12\right),$$ because $\tan15^\circ=2-\sqrt3$.
Substitute the expressions for $p$ and $q$: $$q-ip=t(1+i)c-i\bigl[1+t(1-i)(c-1)\bigr]=t+i(t-1)=(1-i)r.$$ Rearranging yields the key identity $$q-r=i(p-r).$$
The vectors are nonzero. Indeed, if $p=r$, the identity also gives $q=r$, whence $c=r/[t(1+i)]=\tfrac12+i(t-1)/(2t)$, whose imaginary part is negative because $0<t<1$, contradicting $v>0$.
Multiplication by $i$ rotates a nonzero vector through $90^\circ$ and preserves its length. Therefore $q-r=i(p-r)$ gives $\angle QRP=90^\circ$ and $QR=RP$.
stepsZh: 把平面视为复平面。经相似变换并在需要时作反射，可设 $a=0$、$b=1$、$c=u+iv$，其中 $v>0$。以 $p,q,r$ 分别表示 $P,Q,R$ 的复坐标，并令 $$t=\frac{\sqrt3-1}{2}$$。

$P,Q$ 处的其余内角都为 $105^\circ$。由正弦定理，$$\frac{BP}{BC}=\frac{AQ}{AC}=\frac{\sin30^\circ}{\sin105^\circ}=\sqrt2\,t$$。外作方向表明：$BC$ 顺时针旋转 $45^\circ$ 得到 $BP$ 的方向，而 $AC$ 逆时针旋转 $45^\circ$ 得到 $AQ$ 的方向。因此 $$p=1+t(1-i)(c-1),\qquad q=t(1+i)c$$。
三角形 $ABR$ 是等腰三角形，且位于直线 $AB$ 上与 $C$ 相反的一侧。利用从 $R$ 引出的高及 $\tan15^\circ=2-\sqrt3$，得到 $$r=\frac12-\frac i2\tan15^\circ=\frac12+i\left(t-\frac12\right)$$。
代入 $p,q$ 的表达式：$$q-ip=t(1+i)c-i\bigl[1+t(1-i)(c-1)\bigr]=t+i(t-1)=(1-i)r$$。整理得到关键恒等式 $$q-r=i(p-r)$$。
这两个向量非零。否则若 $p=r$，恒等式还给出 $q=r$，于是 $c=r/[t(1+i)]=\tfrac12+i(t-1)/(2t)$。因 $0<t<1$，其虚部为负，与 $v>0$ 矛盾。
非零向量乘以 $i$ 等于逆时针旋转 $90^\circ$，且长度不变。因此由 $q-r=i(p-r)$ 立即得到 $\angle QRP=90^\circ$ 且 $QR=RP$。

imo-1975-q4.summary: Let $A$ be the sum of the decimal digits of $4444^{4444}$, and let $B$ be the sum of the decimal digits of $A$. Find the sum of the decimal digits of $B$.
imo-1975-q4.summaryZh: 设 $A$ 为 $4444^{4444}$ 的十进制各位数字之和，$B$ 为 $A$ 的十进制各位数字之和。求 $B$ 的十进制各位数字之和。

methods.title: Combine digit-sum bounds with congruence modulo $9$
methods.titleZh: 结合数位和估计与模 $9$ 同余
steps: Let $N=4444^{4444}$ and let $C$ be the digit sum of $B$, the number requested. Since $$N<(10^4)^{4444}=10^{17776},$$ the decimal expansion of $N$ has at most $17776$ digits.

Therefore $1\le A\le9\cdot17776=159984<10^6$. Thus $A$ has at most six digits, so $1\le B\le54$. Consequently $B$ has at most two digits and $1\le C\le14$ (the cruder upper bound $5+9$ is already sufficient).
Every positive integer is congruent modulo $9$ to its digit sum. Applying this three times gives $$C\equiv B\equiv A\equiv N\pmod9.$$
Now $4444\equiv7\pmod9$, $7^3\equiv1\pmod9$, and $4444=3\cdot1481+1$. Hence $$N\equiv7^{4444}\equiv7\pmod9,$$ so $C\equiv7\pmod9$.
Among the integers from $1$ through $14$, the only one congruent to $7$ modulo $9$ is $7$. Therefore $C=7$.
stepsZh: 于是 $1\le A\le9\cdot17776=159984<10^6$。因此 $A$ 至多有六位，故 $1\le B\le54$。进而 $B$ 至多有两位，所以 $1\le C\le14$（使用较粗的上界 $5+9$ 已经足够）。
每个正整数与它的十进制数位和模 $9$ 同余。连续应用三次，得到 $$C\equiv B\equiv A\equiv N\pmod9$$。
又有 $4444\equiv7\pmod9$、$7^3\equiv1\pmod9$，且 $4444=3\cdot1481+1$。所以 $$N\equiv7^{4444}\equiv7\pmod9,$$ 从而 $C\equiv7\pmod9$。

imo-1975-q5.summary: Determine whether one can choose $1975$ distinct points on the circumference of a unit circle so that the distance between every pair of chosen points is rational. Give a proof.
imo-1975-q5.summaryZh: 判断能否在单位圆周上选取 $1975$ 个不同的点，使任意两点之间的距离都是有理数，并给出证明。
imo-1975-q5.answer: Yes. The explicit construction in the solution gives not merely $1975$ but infinitely many such points.
imo-1975-q5.answerZh: 可以。解答中的显式构造实际上给出了无穷多个满足条件的点。

methods.title: Square rational points on the unit circle
methods.titleZh: 把单位圆上的有理点作复数平方
steps: For $k=1,2,\ldots,1975$, define $$a_k=\frac{k^2-1}{k^2+1},\qquad b_k=\frac{2k}{k^2+1},\qquad P_k=(a_k^2-b_k^2,\,2a_kb_k).$$ All coordinates are rational.
The standard Pythagorean parametrization gives $$a_k^2+b_k^2=\frac{(k^2-1)^2+4k^2}{(k^2+1)^2}=1.$$ Hence $$(a_k^2-b_k^2)^2+(2a_kb_k)^2=(a_k^2+b_k^2)^2=1,$$ so every $P_k$ lies on the unit circle.
For any $i,j$, expand the squared distance and use $a_i^2+b_i^2=a_j^2+b_j^2=1$ to obtain $$|P_iP_j|^2=4(a_ib_j-a_jb_i)^2.$$ Therefore $|P_iP_j|=2|a_ib_j-a_jb_i|$.
A direct calculation gives $$a_ib_j-a_jb_i=\frac{2(i-j)(ij+1)}{(i^2+1)(j^2+1)}.$$ Thus $$|P_iP_j|=\frac{4|i-j|(ij+1)}{(i^2+1)(j^2+1)},$$ which is rational.
If $i\ne j$, this distance is positive, so the points are distinct. Hence $P_1,\ldots,P_{1975}$ are $1975$ distinct points on the unit circle and every pairwise distance is rational.
stepsZh: 对 $k=1,2,\ldots,1975$，定义 $$a_k=\frac{k^2-1}{k^2+1},\qquad b_k=\frac{2k}{k^2+1},\qquad P_k=(a_k^2-b_k^2,\,2a_kb_k)$$。所有坐标均为有理数。
对任意 $i,j$，展开距离平方并利用 $a_i^2+b_i^2=a_j^2+b_j^2=1$，得到 $$|P_iP_j|^2=4(a_ib_j-a_jb_i)^2$$。因此 $|P_iP_j|=2|a_ib_j-a_jb_i|$。
当 $i\ne j$ 时，上式为正，所以这些点彼此不同。因此 $P_1,\ldots,P_{1975}$ 是单位圆上的 $1975$ 个不同点，任意两点距离均为有理数。

imo-1975-q6.summary: Find all two-variable polynomials $P$ satisfying: (i) for some positive integer $n$, $P(tx,ty)=t^nP(x,y)$ for all real $t,x,y$; (ii) $P(b+c,a)+P(c+a,b)+P(a+b,c)=0$ for all real $a,b,c$; and (iii) $P(1,0)=1$.
imo-1975-q6.summaryZh: 求所有满足下列条件的二元多项式 $P$：(i) 存在正整数 $n$，使对所有实数 $t,x,y$ 有 $P(tx,ty)=t^nP(x,y)$；(ii) 对所有实数 $a,b,c$ 有 $P(b+c,a)+P(c+a,b)+P(a+b,c)=0$；(iii) $P(1,0)=1$。
imo-1975-q6.answer: For every positive integer $n$, $$P(x,y)=(x+y)^{n-1}(x-2y),$$ and these are all the solutions.
imo-1975-q6.answerZh: 对每个正整数 $n$，都有 $$P(x,y)=(x+y)^{n-1}(x-2y),$$ 且这就是全部解。

methods.title: Restrict the homogeneous polynomial to the line $x+y=1$
methods.titleZh: 把齐次多项式限制在直线 $x+y=1$ 上
steps: Suppose $P$ satisfies the conditions and define the one-variable polynomial $$q(u)=P(1-u,u).$$ Condition (iii) gives $q(0)=1$, so $q$ is not the zero polynomial.
In (ii), take $a=b=u$ and $c=1-2u$. Then $$2P(1-u,u)+P(2u,1-2u)=0.$$ Since $(2u)+(1-2u)=1$, this becomes $$2q(u)+q(1-2u)=0$$ for every real $u$.
Let $d$ be the degree of $q$ and let $\lambda\ne0$ be its leading coefficient. Comparing the coefficients of $u^d$ in the last identity gives $\lambda[2+(-2)^d]=0$. Hence $(-2)^d=-2$, so $d=1$.
Putting $u=0$ in the identity gives $q(1)=-2q(0)=-2$. The linear polynomial with $q(0)=1$ and $q(1)=-2$ is therefore $$q(u)=1-3u.$$

If $x+y\ne0$, put $s=x+y$. Homogeneity yields $$P(x,y)=s^nP\left(\frac{x}{s},\frac{y}{s}\right)=s^nq\left(\frac{y}{s}\right)=(x+y)^{n-1}(x-2y).$$ Since both sides are polynomials, the identity extends to $x+y=0$ as well.

Conversely, for any positive integer $n$, set $P(x,y)=(x+y)^{n-1}(x-2y)$. It is homogeneous of degree $n$ and $P(1,0)=1$. If $s=a+b+c$, then the cyclic sum in (ii) equals $$s^{n-1}[(s-3a)+(s-3b)+(s-3c)]=0.$$ Thus every displayed polynomial works, and the classification is complete.
stepsZh: 设 $P$ 满足条件，定义一元多项式 $$q(u)=P(1-u,u)$$。由条件 (iii)，$q(0)=1$，所以 $q$ 不是零多项式。
设 $q$ 的次数为 $d$，首项系数为 $\lambda\ne0$。比较上式中 $u^d$ 的系数，得到 $\lambda[2+(-2)^d]=0$。因此 $(-2)^d=-2$，只能有 $d=1$。
在该恒等式中令 $u=0$，得到 $q(1)=-2q(0)=-2$。结合 $q(0)=1$ 且 $q$ 为一次多项式，可得 $$q(u)=1-3u$$。
若 $x+y\ne0$，令 $s=x+y$。利用齐次性，$$P(x,y)=s^nP\left(\frac{x}{s},\frac{y}{s}\right)=s^nq\left(\frac{y}{s}\right)=(x+y)^{n-1}(x-2y)$$。两边均为多项式，所以该恒等式在 $x+y=0$ 时也成立。
反之，对任意正整数 $n$，令 $P(x,y)=(x+y)^{n-1}(x-2y)$。它是 $n$ 次齐次多项式且 $P(1,0)=1$。若记 $s=a+b+c$，则条件 (ii) 左端为 $$s^{n-1}[(s-3a)+(s-3b)+(s-3c)]=0$$。所以所列多项式全部满足条件，分类完成。
